scientific_integrity: Finite residue and polynomial checks are reproducibility aids only; no finite sample proves infinite natural-density or PNT asymptotics. Residual priority risk from possible equivalent older Schemmel/Jacobsthal formulations.
scientific_limitations: Degree at least two and at least one irrational nonconstant coefficient; natural density first at fixed r, with no uniform joint-growth estimate. Large-prime elimination is invoked from Holdridge (2026); independent mathematical verification has not been performed. Numerical Euler-product factors are already present in a distinct prior split-polynomial problem; originality centers on the specified floor-shifted maximal-run law and prime/composite asymptotics.
title: Prime-resonant maximal coprime-run densities along irrational polynomial floors
